items.title: Q2 Earnings Scorecard: Which sectors outperformed and which fell behind?
items.description: The September quarter results indicate strong revenue and profit growth in sectors like automobiles and banking. In contrast, sectors such as IT and pharmaceuticals showed weakness amid inflationary pressures. Automobile sector leaders like Maruti Suzuki and Bajaj Auto reported significant growth in sales and exports. L&T's orders surged, while the cement sector faced challenges with fluctuating prices.

items.title: MRF Q2 Results: Net profit falls 13% YoY to Rs 417 crore, revenue rises 17%; board declares interim dividend
items.description: MRF reported a 12.9% YoY decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 417 crore in Q2FY27, despite 17.4% revenue growth. EBITDA fell 14.9%, while the board declared an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share.

items.title: Up to 12,000% growth! 181 companies more than doubled profits in Q2 earnings boom for India Inc
items.description: India Inc witnessed a strong earnings recovery in Q2 FY27, with 181 companies more than doubling their net profits year-on-year, according to Ace Equity data. Gains spanned banking, metals, energy, pharmaceuticals and consumer sectors. From Indian Oil and JSW Steel to Paytm and Lenskart, here are the biggest profit gainers and what drove their growth.

items.title: Kalyan Jewellers Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 64% YoY to Rs 427 crore, revenue rises 31%
items.description: Kalyan Jewellers reported a 63.6% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 427 crore in Q2FY27, while revenue grew 31.4% to Rs 10,323 crore. EBITDA increased 29.7%, though margins moderated marginally.
